svg.title: Periodic five-wall raw physiology and numerical diagnostics
svg.desc: Nine plots show group-wise beat closure, left-atrial and left-ventricular pressure-volume loops, pressures, valve and pulmonary venous flows, left-atrial volume, phasic flow ledgers, wall work, and SLS energy. Lines connect raw accepted endpoints without smoothing.
svg.text: Raw terminal-beat physiology and energy ownership
Straight accepted-step segments · no smoothing or time-series resampling · phase colors: reservoir / conduit / pumping
